scenarios.subject: Urgent: Verify your account within 24 hours
scenarios.body:
Dear Student,

Your college portal account requires immediate verificaton. Failure to verify within 24 hours will result in permanent account suspention.

Click here to verify: http://college-portal-verify.com/login

Attachment: account_verification.pdf.exe (2.1 MB)

Regards,
IT Support Team
College Portal Services

clues.explanation: Domain is 'college-support.info' - not the official college domain (.edu)
Creates false urgency to pressure quick action without thinking
Link domain doesn't match sender domain - classic phishing tactic
Spelling errors: 'verificaton' and 'suspention' - professional emails are proofread
Double extension (.pdf.exe) - this is an executable disguised as PDF

scenarios.subject: Your account has been debited
scenarios.body:
ALERT: Rs 49,999 has been debited from your account XXXX1234.

If you did NOT authorize this transaction, call immediately: +91-9876543210

Do NOT call your bank's official number. Our secure line is faster.

Ref: TXN-2024-URGENT-9876

This is an automated message from State Bank customer care.

clues.explanation: Mobile number instead of official bank helpline - red flag

clues.text: Do NOT call your bank's official number
clues.explanation: Actively discourages contacting official channels - major warning sign
Generic sender name, not specific bank name with official domain
High-pressure language designed to bypass rational thinking
Fake transaction ID to appear legitimate - check your actual bank app
